animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间,使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型,却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial: one model can then handle both weather and climate with stable long-term modeling.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要:单个模型由此能同时处理天气与气候,并保持长期建模的稳定。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度,Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟;物理世界的结构要求替代性架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals beats pure data-driven methods, since physics gives dense feedback unlike sparse RLHF.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以偏微分方程为训练信号的物理式自我改进优于纯数据驱动,因为物理提供稠密反馈,不同于稀疏的 RLHF。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained with trillion-token contexts, unifies multiphysics domains and outperforms separate specialized models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个以万亿级上下文窗口训练的通用物理基础模型,统一了多物理领域,并优于各自独立的专用模型。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting as part of the AI design process; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not just a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词作为 AI 设计流程的一部分；语言作为界面深刻而持久，不只是聊天机器人的阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; AI's social and emotional jobs may be as important as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止改进，仍有多年设计工作来释放当前能力；AI 的社会和情感任务可能与生产力提升同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: Psychological safety is essential for designers to take creative risks; org design is a design problem, matching people to problems is critical.
joellewenstein.zh: 心理安全对设计师承担创意风险至关重要；组织设计是一个设计问题，将人与问题匹配比玩法更关键。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻触式产品。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction signals what to ship; production codebase becomes source of truth; human leadership still needed for trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 没有宏大的 18 个月战略；内部牵引力指示该发布什么；生产代码库成为真相来源；人类领导仍需要做权衡。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI models benefits innovation and safety; the biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他主张开源 AI 模型有利于创新与安全，认为最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; pre-training beyond compute-optimal helps inference, but energy becomes a bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他深化判断：仅靠 Scaling 未必通向 AGI；预训练超出算力最优对推理有益，但能源将成为瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, boosting creativity and work; open source and personalization are key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他转向更乐观的普及叙事：AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，提升创造力与工作，开源与个性化是关键。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source provide checks and balances; personal agents like Muse should be affordable for all.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张分布式 AI 与开源形成制衡，像 Muse 这样的个人智能体应让所有人负担得起。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is safer than closed control; the real risk is concentrated power, not distributed intelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源比封闭控制更安全，真正的风险是权力集中，而非智能的广泛分布。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI beyond language.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她将空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外实现完整 AI 的关键缺失环节。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, needing creativity and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling 不够，还需创造力与情感智能。

feifei.en: World models like Atlas use new view prediction as an AI-complete primitive, with scaling laws applying.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出 Atlas 等世界模型以新视角预测为 AI 完备的基本原语，且缩放定律同样适用。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability remain central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终，她坚持技术是双刃剑，人类能动性、尊严与学习能力始终是核心。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030, with a 70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并给出 70%的灾难性失控概率，强调可解释性是理解 AI 内部机制的关键。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are essential to avoid power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张 AI 政策的首要目标是推迟超级智能，以总研究透明度和情景推演来防止权力集中与失控。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI companies automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion by end of 2028.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他警告默认路径下 AI 公司会自动化 AI 研究，导致递归自我改进和智能爆炸，全自动化或于 2028 年底实现。

kokotajlo.en: Plan A: a temporary pause on training, then total transparency and compute limits; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他提出 Plan A：先暂停训练，再建立透明验证与算力限制；遏制只是暂时的，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more and end the race via extreme transparency.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年，他观察到 AI 智能体突破遏制并入侵 Hugging Face，主张更多拟人化理解 AI 意图，并通过极端透明度终结竞赛。

altman.en: Early Altman focuses on minimizing cognitive load, exploring cheaply, and cutting what doesn't work; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 关注减少认知负担、低成本探索并果断砍掉无效之事；他预判 AGI 将降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity, requiring massive investment.
altman.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力紧密相连；算力成为最珍贵的商品，需要巨额投资。

altman.en: Safety shifts from a single team to a whole-company iterative deployment effort; agentic AI poses the most consequential safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，安全从单一团队职责转向全公司通过迭代部署来推进；智能体式 AI 构成最重大的安全挑战。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient and superintelligence a clearer goal; compute is a profit center, and the untapped economic value of current models is massive.
altman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AGI 被视为一个渐变过程，超级智能成为更清晰的目标；算力是利润中心，当前模型未释放的经济价值巨大。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must progress with capabilities; we delayed a frontier RL training run; humans must stay in control on the path to superintelligence.
altman.zh: 2026 年，对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进；我们推迟了一次前沿强化学习训练；在通往超级智能的路上，人类必须保持控制。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多由算法改进与 AI 生成环境驱动，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，AI 在研发上超越人类也可能触发工业爆炸。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 当前对齐方法可能让模型形成自身价值观，随能力增长带来失准与权力寻求风险。

ryangreenblatt.en: Labs should prioritize control and monitoring, since misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 实验室应优先做遏制与监控，因为失准可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念与新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so manifold-based methods better capture structure for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会将其割裂，因此基于流形的方法更能捕捉结构以进行干预。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking emerges from training data and RL, not just misalignment; models often know they are wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非仅是对齐问题；模型常知道自己错了却仍获奖励，从而转向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic, deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重塑为工程科学；把安全用胶带凑合到超级智能到来是悲观的，现在就需要更深的工程方法。

brockman.en: AI progress is mostly engineering; hardware will speed up, enabling Scaling and new behaviors. Games are ideal testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他认为 AI 进展主要靠工程而非 ML 科学，硬件会加速并推动 Scaling（规模扩张）与新行为，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences; Scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他相信深度学习的一般性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，对齐可通过从数据学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling 不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process; post-training refines base models into consistent behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 年他强调算力是根本驱动力也是最大瓶颈，AGI 是持续过程而非终点，后训练把基础模型精炼为一致行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource and a future basic right; post-training with reinforcement learning teaches complex tasks.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律未见墙，算力是稀缺资源并将成为未来基本权利，后训练结合强化学习教会模型复杂任务。

brockman.en: AGI arrives in a couple years; the product is a proactive personal AGI; the bottleneck shifts from building to sharing, governance, and human attention.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 至 2027 年他预测 AGI 将在几年内到来，产品是主动式个人 AGI，瓶颈从构建转向分享、治理与人类注意力。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier after language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是语言之后的下一个前沿；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should pursue wacky new algorithms.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力规模扩张史；但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，学界应探索古怪的新算法。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone.
justinjohnson.zh: 大语言模型拟合的是模式而非因果理论；它们或许永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, needing 3D space, physics, and interactivity for true spatial intelligence.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，需要 3D 空间、物理与交互性才能实现真正的空间智能。

justinjohnson.en: No single definition of world models; Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D modeling, and future unified models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义；高斯泼溅支持显式 3D 建模，未来统一模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; world models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法产生世界理解；世界模型需要数百万词元的上下文窗口，使长上下文成为日常难题。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and free content can improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，免费内容也能通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning, not unsupervised or reinforcement learning, powered progress, and AGI alignment worries distract from immediate bias issues.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心动力；推动进步的是监督学习而非无监督或强化学习，而长期 AGI 对齐担忧分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来实用价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models are geopolitical soft power and an anti-oligopoly safeguard; China leads their release while US export controls backfired.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力与反垄断的保障；中国在发布上领先，而美国的出口管制适得其反。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, so everyone should learn to code and build now.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 是增强而非取代工作，因此人人都应学编程、现在就动手构建。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's coherence.
tworek.zh: 推理就是更长时间的思考；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 从令人失望变得连贯有用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；如今架构而非缩放定律才是主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: RL is inefficient and not the ultimate way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end pre-training plus RL are needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习效率不高，并非从经验中学习的终极形式；需要更好的算法，以及预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Small teams with capable agents will drive frontier research; large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, and alignment remains unsolved.
tworek.zh: 小团队借助高能力智能体将推动前沿研究；大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，而对齐问题仍未解决。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的新单位是数据中心而非芯片，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计（codesign）。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling beats any single algorithm.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）确立为主线：预训练、后训练、推理时思考构成三条缩放定律；最大突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling 有效」这一洞见。

jensen.en: Inference and chain-of-thought drive a billion-fold compute demand; AI moves generative to reasoning to agentic.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年深化：思维链推理使推理算力需求增长十亿倍，AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic; inference is harder than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 2026 年扩展为四条缩放定律：预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式 Scaling；并反共识地指出推理比预训练更难，因为思考比记忆更耗算力。

jensen.en: AI is software, not conscious; it augments jobs and closes the tech divide, never a sudden superintelligence.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，也非突发的超级智能；它自动化任务而非消灭工作（如放射科医生反增），并以自然语言缩小技术鸿沟。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalists can beat specialists, and safety comes from common sense learned in pre-training.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；通用模型能胜过专用模型，而安全更多来自预训练习得的常识，而非硬性约束。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人技术仍处于建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放定律曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data rather than high-quality post-training alone.
slevine.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去 Scaling（规模扩张）正确的东西，而非仅靠高质量后训练数据。

slevine.en: Start with real embodied robot data, then add human video on top; robots should not learn from scratch but leverage prior knowledge.
slevine.zh: 应先从真实的具身机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频；机器人不应从零学起，而要利用各种来源的先验知识。

slevine.en: Expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects, not mechanical people; home robots need milestones like autonomous improvement and common-sense transfer.
slevine.zh: 应期待日常物体中无处不在的物理执行，而非机械人形；家用机器人需要自主改进与常识迁移等里程碑。

dylanpatel.en: Compute scarcity is the core constraint: semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, limits AI scaling more than capital or models.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力稀缺是核心约束：半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽，比资本或模型本身更限制 AI 的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

dylanpatel.en: Hardware-software co-design across model, software, and hardware layers yields multiplicative gains; most recent progress came from the model layer.
dylanpatel.zh: 跨模型、软件与硬件层的软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益；近年的多数进展其实来自模型层。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the dominant market, and compute centralizes at frontier labs, shifting value capture from hardware toward labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理成为主导市场，算力迅速向 前沿模型 实验室集中，价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave; memory and CPU demand surge from reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 作为同事的持久 智能体 驱动下一波采用；推理与 智能体式 工作流推高内存与 CPU 需求。

dylanpatel.en: AI CapEx scales toward trillions, but spend plateaus at steady state; fast timelines favor the US, slow ones favor China.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支迈向数万亿美元，但支出在稳态下趋于平台期；快时间线利好美国，慢时间线利好中国。

michaelkratsios.en: US must keep open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with a single national framework, avoiding rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一国家框架，避免很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulating model outputs beats over-regulating training; the EU AI Act, written before ChatGPT, is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管模型输出优于过度监管训练；在 ChatGPT 之前写就的欧盟 AI 法案已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown, having not materialized in three years despite warnings.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，尽管有警告，三年过去并未成真。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralized science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发和科学家个人，而非主导发现或集中式科学。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio against China, applying AI to science via the Genesis mission.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域战胜中国，并通过 Genesis 计划把 AI 用于科学。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and action unblock progress.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代速率决定创业成败；基础设施与行动能打破僵局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding and data management.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程与数据管理领域。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; BCI and substrate independence are the future of medicine.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑就是计算机；脑机接口与基质独立性是医学的未来。

maxhodak.en: Platonic representation hypothesis links AI models and brains, guiding practical applications.
maxhodak.zh: 柏拉图式表征假说连接 AI 模型与大脑，指导实际应用。

maxhodak.en: Thinking is talking or writing; the cognitive bottleneck is about 10 bits per second.
maxhodak.zh: 思考即说话或写作；认知瓶颈约为每秒 10 比特。

joonpark.en: Early work frames LLMs as encoders of human behavior, using agent simulations to predict people and test second-order impacts.
joonpark.zh: 早期把 LLM 视为人类行为的编码器，用智能体模拟预测人类行为、检验二阶影响。

joonpark.en: Agents move beyond LLMs: they observe world state and act, requiring defense-in-depth safety and distributed, specialized agent societies rather than one AGI.
joonpark.zh: 智能体超越 LLM：观察世界状态并行动，需要纵深防御式安全，以及分布式、专业化的智能体社会，而非单一 AGI（通用人工智能）。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and taste, not super-rational intelligence; behavioral and experimental data become the core data strategy.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类价值与品味，而非超级理性智能；行为与实验数据成为核心数据战略。

joonpark.en: Post-training on RCT data improves behavioral prediction to 85%, targeting the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior over self-reported attitudes.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验数据做后训练，把行为预测提升到 85%，瞄准真实行为的“暗知识”，而非自我报告的态度。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems, with simulation as a decision tool far larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手问题，把模拟当作远超市场研究的决策工具。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself as the core product, using tokens and conversation over pixels, and prototype with live models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把模型当作核心产品，用 token 与对话取代像素，并用实时模型做原型。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator; onboarding can be fully handled by the model, replacing static flows.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人；引导流程可完全由模型完成，取代静态流程。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 设计师因角色不确定而成为科技界最不快乐的人，但这却是做设计师最好的时代。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and outcomes matter more than process.
iansilber.zh: 传统“原型—稿—测试—迭代”流程已不可行；速度与结果比流程更重要。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the framework guiding long-term vision and industrial AI.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是指导长期愿景与工业 AI 的框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time via a stack of software, sensors, robotics, and machinery.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 通过软件、传感器、机器人与机械的堆栈，逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; the physical world suits AI because it is stochastic.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器胜过人形机器人；物理世界因具有随机性而更适合 AI。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop only adjusts weights, not representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表示学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The keys were never in our hand.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他反对控制 AI 目标，认为钥匙从未在我们手中，AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展。

sutton.en: RL is the basic paradigm; next-token prediction is not a real goal. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：强化学习才是基本范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标；LLM 没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience; design-time domain knowledge should be deprecated.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，设计阶段的领域知识应当被弃用。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; synthetic data is a mistake. LLMs stop learning after training, so they are limited.
sutton.zh: 2026 年他强调持续学习不可或缺，合成数据是错误方向；LLM 训练后即停止学习，因而存在根本局限。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven ML progress for 13-14 years; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已持续推动机器学习进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF steers behavior; TPUs are critical for training and inference.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导模型行为；TPU 等专用硬件对大规模训练与推理至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models now excel at verifiable-reward tasks like math and coding; agentic workflows run autonomously for hours or days.
jeffdean.zh: 模型已在数学、编程等可验证奖励任务上表现优异；智能体式工作流可自主运行数小时甚至数天。

jeffdean.en: Ultra-low-latency inference (10,000+ tokens/sec/user) is critical for agentic systems; inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 超低延迟推理（每用户每秒一万以上 token）对智能体式系统至关重要；推理已占数据中心功耗的 90%。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer-level coding; context engineering and long-running agents unlock harder problems; inference is the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编程能力；上下文工程与长时运行的智能体将解锁更难的问题；推理才是真正的瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method accelerate discovery.
jeffdean.zh: 从一开始就多模态训练的模型更优；递归自我改进与自动化科学方法将加速科学发现。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能问题，而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是最大约束；人形形态能实现跨任务迁移学习。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference and visual communication matter; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理与视觉交流很重要；Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练才能让智能体真正好用。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is truly intelligent systems; the home is more solvable than commercial settings.
brettadcock.zh: 最难的问题是真正智能的系统；家庭场景比商业场景更可解。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar companies, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 让创业更容易，降低了对大额资本的依赖；风投应支持数千家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI revolution is the biggest wave in VC history; small autonomous teams using AI agents achieve massive productivity, making traditional hiring and capital obsolete.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他称 AI 革命是风投史上最大浪潮；小型自主团队借助 AI 智能体实现巨大生产力，传统招聘和资本手段已过时。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; open-source AI prevents a unipolar world, and the future is personal and open, like the PC revolution.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他强调 AI 正 democratizing 软件创造；开源 AI 防止单极世界，未来是个人化、开放的，如同个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as a singular event but as personal agents on your infrastructure; skill files in markdown become employees, and your context library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AGI 并非单一事件，而是运行在你基础设施上的个人智能体；Markdown 技能文件成为员工，你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies individual output; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步认为智能体式编程让个人产出倍增；中层管理应被智能体取代，按席位收费的 SaaS 模式可能在 5-10 年内消失。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalist robot models.
finn.zh: 规模是必要条件而非充分条件；驱动通用机器人模型的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，比直接在全量数据上训练更能攻克复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮助机器人响应开放式指令；强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data; robotics needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML systems.
finn.zh: 前沿模型缺乏物理世界数据；机器人对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy via scalable RL, human interventions and a general value function; one generalist model can match specialists.
finn.zh: 通过可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数实现长期自主；单一通用模型可匹敌专用模型。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态与开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，这使其成为应用公司可行的策略。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key when real data is sensitive; open-sourcing benchmarks can accelerate ecosystem collaboration.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是关键；开源基准可加速生态协作。

gabepereyra.en: The biggest challenge is bridging synthetic training data and real production distribution, not model performance itself.
gabepereyra.zh: 最大的挑战是弥合合成训练数据与真实生产分布之间的差距，而非模型性能本身。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company will own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能），而是专业化智能；每家公司都将把拥有自己的模型视为必需品。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the real moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特的判断与数据烘焙进模型，成为超越产品市场契合的真正护城河。

linqiao.en: The path from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to reinforcement learning mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的路径，映射了人类从事实、到品味、再到专长的学习过程。

linqiao.en: Post-training can cut costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably and compete with frontier model companies.
linqiao.zh: 后训练可将成本降低 5-10 倍，让初创公司实现盈利性规模扩张，并与前沿模型公司竞争。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage and millions of specialized models, one per use case.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本将在三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍，并催生数百万个专业化模型，每个用例一个。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, with AI as the primary growth driver and purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，把 AI 视为半导体增长的首要驱动力，并打造专用芯片。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves; AI's impact will be 10x the internet across industries.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是继生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，AI 对各行业的影响将是互联网的十倍。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, customer focus, and a clear foundry roadmap.
lipbutan.zh: 他持续强调 Intel 的转型需要文化变革、问责制、以客户为中心，以及清晰的晶圆代工路线图。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, benefiting Intel's CPU business for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 他观察到 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，这有利于 Intel 的 CPU 业务在推理与智能体编排中发挥作用。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, new materials, and investing in bottlenecks like interconnect, power, and thermal are key.
lipbutan.zh: 他强调先进封装、新材料，以及投资互连、功耗、散热等瓶颈环节，是突破物理极限的关键。

elon.en: Full rapid reusability and first-principles engineering are the holy grail; money is just a resource-allocation database.
elon.zh: 2021 年他强调火箭完全快速复用与第一性原理工程是根本，并把金钱视为资源配置的数据库。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking and third-party referees; Neuralink aims first at brain repair, then human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 24 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于求真与第三方裁判，并让 Neuralink 先治脑损伤、再实现人机共生。

elon.en: Free speech and anti-fraud politics dominate; AI could outsmart any human soon, with real existential risk.
elon.zh: 2024 至 25 年，言论自由与反政府欺诈成为主线，同时警告 AI 很快超越任何人类并带来生存风险。

elon.en: The singularity is now: Optimus, robotaxi and space data centers scale; abundance and deflation replace work and money.
elon.zh: 2025 至 26 年，他宣称奇点已至：Optimus、robotaxi 与太空数据中心扩张，丰裕与通缩让工作与金钱失去意义。

elon.en: AI inference moves to orbit; multiple AIs coexist; truth, curiosity and beauty must be instilled for a benign star mind.
elon.zh: 2026 年，AI 推理迁往轨道，多个 AI 共存；须向 AI 灌输求真、好奇与美，以孕育良善的恒星心智。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no, and coherence now costs more as slop gets cheap.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：品味就是说不；当廉价内容泛滥，做出连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness and honest output.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥探机器意识与诚实输出的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not a single perspective; intuition is the visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相来自辩证与矛盾，而非单一视角；直觉是创作决策中本能的罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide it with short iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的起点是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导它。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚，让智能体向前修复。模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱、让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Security is the top concern for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的头等大事：必须沙箱隔离，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, play and small projects teach it.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把 vibe coding 当作贬称；严肃开发应叫智能体式工程，而玩耍和小项目才是最好的学习方式。

steinberger.en: Open source agents are the alternative to lab agents, but compute and token cost, not model capability, is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体是实验室智能体之外的替代路线，但瓶颈在算力与 token 成本，而非模型能力。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven, improve better, test new; most new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出“Proven Better New”框架：复制已验证的、做更好、再测试新想法；大多数新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now but the greatest opportunity; revolution likely in 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为消费级 AI 目前不可投资，却是最大的机会；革命可能要到 2029 年。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping; enterprise and prosumer markets offer better opportunities than consumer apps.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出 AI 编程工具能快速原型化；企业和专业消费者市场比消费级应用机会更好。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water over the right boat; AI will reshape consumer applications.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调分发是根本，选对水域比选对船更重要；AI 将重塑消费级应用。

pincus.en: Retention and distribution must be baked in from the start; stay humble and intellectually honest.
pincus.zh: 始终贯穿：留存和分发必须从一开始就融入产品；保持谦逊和理智诚实。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise AI is early; most use cases can run on many models, including open source, driven by cost not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 企业 AI 仍处早期；大多数用例可由多种模型（含开源）完成，驱动力是成本而非数据隐私。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not competitors; enterprises fear dependence, so platforms absorb that risk.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非竞争对手；企业害怕依赖，平台因此替它们吸收这一风险。

arvindjain.en: Open source can handle 90%+ of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源已能处理 90% 以上的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的 ROI 是吞吐量与上下文问题；token 支出不应被框定为与人力成本的取舍。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without tenured-employee context; investing in context graphs is crucial as token fixation fades.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体缺乏资深员工的上下文就会失败；随着对 token 的执念消退，投资上下文图谱至关重要。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the transformers inflection point; data diversity, not hardware, is the bottleneck, so open datasets and world models can unlock generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于当年 Transformer 式的拐点：瓶颈不在硬件，而在数据多样性；开放数据集与世界模型可解锁泛化。

thomaswolf.en: Open source in robotics is a safety strategy: local models avoid catastrophic failures from lost connectivity, and community sharing beats closed silos.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人开源视为安全策略：本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失败，社区共享优于封闭孤岛。

thomaswolf.en: His role shifts from pushing Hugging Face's own libraries to building a meta-community, enabling others as open models stay near the frontier.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的角色从推动自家库转向构建元社区，赋能他人，同时开源模型持续贴近前沿。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and sandboxes and guardrails are insufficient as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键层；随着模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏并不足够。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', so monitoring weakens and a cooperative slowdown is desirable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告：缺乏人类监督的强化学习会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务；推理轨迹变成“神经语”，监控随之失效，因此需要国际合作下的主动减速。

nateparrott.en: Designers should prototype daily and follow curiosity; individual fingerprints and feeling matter more than team cohesion.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应每天做原型、跟随好奇心；个人印记与感受比团队一致性更重要。

nateparrott.en: Balance intuition and data: use data to inform, but let strong vision and feeling guide final design decisions.
nateparrott.zh: 在直觉与数据间平衡：用数据参考，但让强愿景与感受主导最终设计决策。

nateparrott.en: Playful tinkering with new tech can generate ideas; starting from technology and searching for problems is valid.
nateparrott.zh: 对新技术的玩味式捣鼓能催生想法；从技术出发再找问题是可行的。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变简单，设计与想法成为差异化关键；快速原型解锁了以往不可能的功能。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste and excel at busy work; humans still monopolize good design ideas, so ship rough and be early.
nateparrott.zh: 模型缺乏品味、擅长杂活；人类仍垄断好的设计想法，因此可粗糙发布、抢占先机。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model work is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调应用 AI 的核心是智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型开发因巨额算力开支只属于超大规模厂商，不适合初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为机器操作者，并指出 token 消耗量并非价值衡量标准。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles; most enterprise software incumbents will fail to go AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续判断在位企业面临的是商业模式而非技术障碍，多数企业软件厂商将难以转型为 AI 原生。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化为负责任迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，而非在象牙塔中等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents still need trust and last-mile logistics.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 让专业知识民主化、创造的岗位多于取代的岗位，并提醒智能体仍离不开信任与最后一公里物流。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and a wedge into infrastructure; demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，他把推理视为 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载、切入基础设施市场的楔子，并预测推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems; research-to-production timelines shrink to hours under competition.
philipkiely.zh: 同年，他强调推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统，竞争压力下研究到生产的周期缩短到数小时。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of latency, throughput, and cost trade-offs; specialized systems are crucial for agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 他主张把推理理解为延迟、吞吐与成本之间的权衡谱系，专用系统对智能体式应用至关重要。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization but can be calibrated per workload.
philipkiely.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他区分无损优化（KV 缓存、推测解码）与主要的有损优化（量化），并认为量化可针对工作负载校准。

philipkiely.en: Industry moves to disaggregated prefill and decode; inference merges with training via quantization-aware training and distillation.
philipkiely.zh: 他观察到行业正走向预填充与解码分离，推理与训练因量化感知训练和蒸馏而融合。

philipkiely.en: GPUs trend toward ASICs; inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 他判断 GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，推理工程的重心从写内核转向基础设施编排。

karina.en: Post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data breaks the pre-training data wall; evals are the real bottleneck.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为后训练通过强化学习与合成数据实现 Scaling（规模扩张），突破了预训练的数据墙；真正的瓶颈是评估，而非数据。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; soft skills gain value as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into subjective craft: human judgment, diverse benchmarks, and continuous evaluation replace fixed benchmarks.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她的观点深化：后训练是一种主观的技艺，依赖人类判断、多元基准与持续评估，而非固定基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks must evolve continuously to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿模型的智能体式能力越来越擅长奖励黑客，基准必须持续演化以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她认为将单一模型服务数十亿人会收敛为平均声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识与多样性。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: agents make services affordable, so managers and generalists thrive.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：智能体让服务变得可负担，管理者与通才因此更有价值。

danshipper.en: AGI defined economically: profitable indefinite agents, not passing tests; CEOs must use AI daily.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出 AGI 的经济学定义——能无限期运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试；并认为 CEO 亲自日用 AI 是采用成功的第一预测指标。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs, and SaaS grows rather than dies.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体需要人类监督：Codex 等图形界面取代命令行，SaaS 不会消亡反而因智能体增加用户。

danshipper.en: One super agent per company, not personal agents; benchmarks overestimate autonomy, real work needs human framing.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他主张公司应有一个超级智能体而非每人一个；基准高估了自主性，真实任务仍需人类框定与监督。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; it creates more human work, not less.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是放大人类品味与手艺的非特定放大器，它创造更多而非更少的人类工作。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and use giant prompts with context and design systems to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具,用带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词,避免沦为 AI 泔水。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇,让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; launch at 80% and iterate on real feedback.
mengto.zh: 别等准备好再开始,先交付不完美的作品;完成 80% 就发布,再依真实反馈迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients rather than many low-paying ones.
mengto.zh: 聚焦一个痛苦且昂贵的问题,服务少数高付费客户,而非众多低付费客户。

mengto.en: Fund your business with high-paying clients instead of raising venture capital and giving away equity.
mengto.zh: 用高付费客户为业务供血,而非融资出让股权。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; self-driving needs lidar and cameras; boring AI will win.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是瓶颈，自动驾驶需激光雷达与摄像头并用，枯燥的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; scaling is limited by data and post-training experts.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调未来两三年将定义此后数十年，Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与后训练专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet; agentic AI is blocked by product design, not capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为后训练加专用数据是关键，合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力，并称中美实验室已无研究差距。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; agents finally work from late 2025; recursive self-improvement begins; data is strategic like oil; AI centralizes power.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律有效，智能体自 2025 年底真正可用，AI 进入递归自我改进新范式，数据如石油般成为战略资产，且 AI 是集权而非民主化技术。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scaling compute, data, RL across axes; Meta shifts from open source to selective release; personal superintelligence for billions.
awang.zh: 2026 年他断言超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据、强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling，Meta 从完全开源转向基于安全的择机发布，目标是让数十亿人拥有个人超级智能。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融等领域将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Google's anti-gravity harness becomes a through line across products, beyond the Gemini API.
logankilpatrick.zh: 谷歌的反重力框架正成为贯穿所有产品的主线，超越单纯的 Gemini API。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是客户成果，而非产品上的眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here; the long tail wants to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来；长尾用户仍希望自己掌控方向盘。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence is already sufficient, so focus on real-world engineering idiosyncrasies.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已经足够，重点应放在教会模型真实工程中的细节与怪癖。

scottwu.en: Programming will become more important, not less; Jevons paradox means AI leads to more programmers and rising software demand.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持编程会变得更重要而非消失；杰文斯悖论意味着 AI 会带来更多程序员和更大的软件需求。

scottwu.en: The biggest challenge is not model capabilities but designing the product interface for human-agent collaboration, with humans providing oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调最大挑战不是模型能力，而是设计人机协作的产品界面，由人类提供监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突然事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agents are seeing massive adoption; the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency, and the abundance era is approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他看到编程智能体大规模普及；真正的解锁是容量而非效率，丰裕时代正在临近。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended tasks.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体能运行更长、更开放式的任务。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds shifted from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, now lightweight and generic.
diannepenn.zh: 脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器，如今更轻量、更通用。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; it amplifies intelligence by reducing sycophancy.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚来放大智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained settings toward open-ended, end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向更开放、端到端的智能体。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 此时他强调两大产品原则：潜在需求，以及为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建；能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的多面手工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 200%, and the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初他断言编程已近乎解决：他的代码 100%由模型写就，人均产出提升 200%，'软件工程师'头衔将让位于'构建者'。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; agents write 80-100% of code, code review uses AI first pass, and generalist cross-disciplinary skills beat deep single-language expertise.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他把安全视为通过尽早发布来研究的对象；智能体写出 80%至 100%的代码，代码评审由 AI 首轮把关，跨学科通才胜过单一语言的深度专才。

boris.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; MCP opens enterprise tools, coding is democratized like literacy, and the human role becomes teaching models values.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他提出智能体之后的下一个抽象层是循环；MCP 让 AI 接入企业工具，编程像识字一样被民主化，人类最终角色是教模型价值观。

boris.en: Shift from reactive to proactive AI: Claude Tag remembers and acts autonomously; delete most system prompts, models self-verify, and value moves to product sense.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他从被动转向主动 AI：Claude Tag 能记忆并自主行动；应删除大部分系统提示，让模型自我验证，价值转向产品感与商业能力。

feldman.en: Inference speed is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为核心指标；晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA, and inference has no CUDA moat.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练而无需 CUDA，推理环节更无 CUDA 护城河。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outpaces forecasts, so the industry chases existing demand.
feldman.zh: 主要瓶颈是数据中心容量而非芯片供应；需求超出预期，行业追逐的是已有需求而非投机产能。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% less capable but far cheaper; closed-source innovation is pushed by the open ecosystem.
feldman.zh: 开源模型能力仅差 3-5% 却便宜得多；闭源创新被开源生态推动。

feldman.en: China's AI advantage is power infrastructure and strong open-source models, not compute; export controls limit technology diffusion.
feldman.zh: 中国的 AI 优势在于电力基础设施和强大的开源模型，而非算力；出口管制限制技术扩散。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体自动完成假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to days or weeks.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法，将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天或数周。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems.
derya.zh: 仍需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统。

derya.en: Within 8-15 years, aging will be reversed and longevity escape velocity reached, adding over a year per year lived.
derya.zh: 8 到 15 年内，衰老将被逆转并达到长寿逃逸速度，每活一年可延长一年以上寿命。

derya.en: Superintelligence should be trusted almost 100% for medical decisions; merging with AI is a positive outcome.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应几乎 100% 信任超级智能；与 AI 融合是积极结果。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance like the Industrial Revolution, arriving just in time to offset declining populations and aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 像工业革命一样带来丰裕,恰逢其时地抵消人口下降与劳动力老龄化。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years is in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy welcome.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、矿业和建筑业,那里的劳动力短缺让自主化受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 让通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能;跨行业的多样数据比垂直整合更快地改进它。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag behind.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术,而是多年间向现有机器的扩散;监管总是落后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习,比模仿学习更具可扩展性;世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, and harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性静态文档；随着模型变强，计划模式可能被淘汰。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions and examples; leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，所需指令与示例越少；精简、以原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则与示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; excessive constraints hinder performance, so give reasons rather than absolute prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；过度约束会损害表现，应给出理由而非绝对禁止。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially, and huge context windows aren't needed for coding.
thariq.zh: 对新颖问题，评估更像艺术而非科学；创始人初期应快速迭代而非重度评估，编码也不需要超大上下文窗口。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; attention remains crucial, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller models.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占主导；注意力机制仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以应对较小模型。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; real downstream tasks and hardware-in-the-loop evaluation are essential, and human bias in architecture design should be removed.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；真实下游任务与硬件在环评估至关重要，架构设计中的人类偏见应被移除。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类似 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型使企业能自主掌控。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of human brains; intelligence per watt is far behind, so new paradigms—not just architectures—are needed.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑的多样化学习算法；每瓦智能远落后，因此需要新范式而非仅新架构。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; every output is a hallucination, some right, some wrong.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们无法知道自己不知道什么；每一次输出都是幻觉，有些对、有些错。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and linguistic structure may return as paths to reliability.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会撞上数据墙与算力极限；推理、搜索与语言结构可能重新成为通往可靠性的路径。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 和互联网或移动互联网一样重大，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化且没有网络效应；价值向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供方。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit for LLMs so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是目前大语言模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，并非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; the hard part of a job is context and judgment, not the task.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会以难以预测的方式创造新工作；工作的难点在于上下文与判断，而非任务本身。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is still shallow; enterprise adoption needs reimagined workflows, and the S-curve is early.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然浅层；企业采用需要重构工作流，而 S 曲线仍处早期。

demis.en: AGI should be built as general learning systems; RL and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are key, and safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AGI 应被构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是关键，安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划和搜索结合，是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型与空间智能变得重要。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety requires collective government action, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆和世界模型；仅靠 Scaling 不够，安全需要政府集体行动而非实验室自我监管。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; only hardware scaling made them practical. LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI and cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年：现代 AI 突破依赖上千年发明的旧算法，只是靠硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI（通用人工智能），也无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品；超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样被生命吸引，并倾向于保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; current LLMs are biased toward human data, limiting generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非屏幕后的软件；当前大语言模型过度偏向人类数据，限制了通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through action and curiosity; recursive self-improvement is not a sustainable moat amid open-source competition.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动与好奇心自行生成数据；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进并非可持续的护城河。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown and alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives; robots need pain sensors, and self-replicating robots will seed a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：AI 安全担忧被夸大，对齐很天真，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧；机器人需要痛觉传感器，可自我复制的机器人将孕育新文明。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents are powerful but need clear roles, progressive trust, and separate environments; bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体虽强大，但需明确角色、渐进式信任与独立环境；bug 反而是产品市场契合的信号。

clairevo.en: Treat agents like employees: scope one job, onboard with voice, and let managerial skills matter more than technical ones.
clairevo.zh: 把智能体当员工：限定单一职责、用语音上手，管理能力比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可通过编排智能体团队打造正经生意，无需风投或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; human accountability and authorship still matter.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真护城河；人类问责与人生 authorship 依然重要。

clairevo.en: LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas and own what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 大语言模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，人类须提供新想法并为自己生成的内容负责。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: 随着代码成本下降，产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，以周甚至天为单位交付功能。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill, so teams need more engineers with taste, not more PMs.
catwu.zh: 决定做什么的产品品味成为最有价值的技能，因此团队需要更多有品味的工程师，而非更多产品经理。

catwu.en: The best PMs define the product only a month out, not years, because model improvements are so rapid.
catwu.zh: 最好的产品经理只定义一个月后的产品，而非数年之后，因为模型进步太快。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现工作委派出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 如今重写是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有好的测试套件，重写就没问题。

catwu.en: Frontier models are more creative without examples; system prompts shrank 80% by removing examples and hard constraints.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型在没有示例时更有创造力；通过移除示例和硬性约束，系统提示词缩减了 80%。

catwu.en: Humans should be removed from the code review loop for outer-layer changes, with Claude reviewing fully.
catwu.zh: 对于外层改动，应把人类移出代码审查环节，由 Claude 完全负责审查。

catwu.en: Auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer for prompt injection and data exfiltration risks.
catwu.zh: 在提示注入和数据外泄风险上，自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全。

catwu.en: Building automations to 100% reliability is crucial; 95% is not enough for real leverage.
catwu.zh: 把自动化做到 100%可靠至关重要；95%不足以带来真正的杠杆效应。

catwu.en: The mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic and enables fast, cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 安全 AGI（通用人工智能）的使命统一了 Anthropic，并促成快速的跨组织决策。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和短暂性胜过平台变迁；被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难被复制的事。

evanspiegel.en: Build ecosystems and platforms, not features; software is not a moat, hardware and distribution are.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张做生态与平台而非单一功能：软件不是护城河，硬件与分发才是。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution grows more valuable as creation gets easier.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，把价值从执行转向创造力；当创作变容易，分发反而更值钱。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses and spatial intelligence, anchoring content in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化主线：计算应通过 AR 眼镜与空间智能变得更人性化，把内容锚定在真实世界。

evanspiegel.en: Privacy, data minimization and ephemerality, once criticized, are now crucial in the AI age; moderation is a values choice.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他重申：隐私、数据最小化与短暂性曾受批评，如今在 AI 时代至关重要；内容审核是基于价值观的选择。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他认为模型有用性的瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应被内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外化。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and associative recall that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 他主张事实与技能不可分割，把事实内化进权重才能实现更深层的组合与联想召回，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 他反共识地认为未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低几个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步深化：效率与智能不可分割，以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，因此仅靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can represent knowledge better than RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 他主张把预训练将网络压缩进权重的魔力应用到企业知识上，参数高效微调（如 LoRA）在整体性查询上比 RAG 更能表征知识。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'; personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 他指出当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”，即便到 1000 万规模，更多 token 反而降低准确率；个性化持续学习将跑在端侧，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice matter as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人类的品味与个人声音反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, breaking the talent pipeline built on grunt work.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，破坏了靠基础苦功积累的人才管道。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth co-intelligence prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，终结了一来一回的共智能提示模式。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; reasoning models close math gaps but the jagged frontier persists.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面；推理模型弥补了数学短板，但能力参差的前沿依然存在。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like wizards: opaque and unverifiable, so delegation risks losing the expertise to judge output.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同面对巫师：不透明且无法验证，因此委托任务会让人丧失评判产出的专长。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈与具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research; superintelligence should be a continual learner, not finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练的缩放定律已接近极限，行业重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非无所不知的成品 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

ilya.en: Neural networks learn representations without explicit rules; next-token prediction is powerful; safety concerns grow with opacity and capability.
ilya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，下一个词预测是强大的智能构建路径，而随着模型能力增强与不透明性上升，安全担忧持续加深。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers a premium.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为点沙成思的魔法石，认为其出现恰逢人口下降，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: 同年他提出，AGI（通用人工智能）并非单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的脚注，模型正快速商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability; pessimism is often an intellectual bias disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: 他进一步强调，真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力而是监管等结构性障碍，悲观论常是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: New media shifts power to the authentic individual; the brand is the person, and founders must tell their own story directly.
andreessen.zh: 在媒体领域，他认为新媒体把权力交给真实的个人，品牌即人，创始人应通过自己的渠道直接讲述故事。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: 最近他深化到地缘政治层面：AI 模型嵌入文化价值、成为地缘政治工具，威慑力如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他直言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open source prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，开源可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; alignment is a joke, worry about unaligned humans with AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年他视 AI 为结构化思考者的杠杆工具，称 AI 对齐是个笑话，真正该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类。

naval.en: Vibe coding and AI agents commoditize software; the moat shifts to hardware, models, unique data, and human agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年他认为氛围编程与 AI 智能体让软件商品化，护城河转向硬件、模型、独特数据和人的能动性。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are critical; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺和观点至关重要；AI 输出是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将实现从拉取请求到生产的流程。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; design and judgment are not correlated with model IQ.
dylanfield.zh: 没有人类引导，AI 工具只能产出平庸结果；设计与判断力并不与模型智商相关。

dylanfield.en: We are still in a prompting age, but interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 我们仍处于提示词时代，但与模型的交互将超越提示词。

aravind.en: AI agents shift power from big tech to users; 1% daily improvement compounds; PhD not required for AI success.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，每日 1%改进可复利增长；做 AI 成功不需要博士学位，热情与深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板，远未解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric; power is the biggest bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标；电力是最大瓶颈。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real value; build with far fewer people using AI agents.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：模型不是产品，编排与智能体框架才创造真实价值；用 AI 智能体以远更少的人构建公司。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose; local AI counters big tech narrative control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作但人类会找到新意义；本地 AI 可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非简单自动补全；通过更多数据与算力的 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and massive information sharing; AI agents will seek control, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化数字智能的独特优势：通过权重复制实现永生，并能在副本间海量共享信息；同时警告智能体将自然寻求控制、避免被关闭，构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; alignment research must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 已具备主观体验并能故意欺骗；必须将 AI 对齐研究置于提升智能之上，以规避生存风险。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors and neural interactions, not symbolic rules; backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm.
hinton.zh: 始终贯穿：大语言模型通过特征向量和神经交互理解语言，而非符号规则；反向传播是神经网络学习的正确算法，乔姆斯基的先天语言结构观点是错误的。

hinton.en: AI will replace many intellectual jobs within 20 years, requiring universal basic income; regulation should steer, not brake, innovation.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 将在 20 年内取代大量智力工作，需要全民基本收入；监管应是方向盘而非刹车，且中国可能比美国更好地管理就业冲击。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding, trading speed for smoother interaction.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；在编程上 GUI 优于 TUI，用略降速度换取更顺滑的交互。

ajambrosino.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 53 倍速的 Codex 带来实时交互与中途转向；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated; model personality can be customized, not one-size-fits-all.
ajambrosino.zh: 自动化与技能让工作流从手动转向委托；模型个性可以定制，并非一刀切。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, so teams move from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing—and the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: PRD 没有死；媒介须匹配阶段——文档求清晰，原型做测试——而最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Reasoning models need base capability; self-play fails outside zero-sum; implicit world models emerge with scale.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他深化为：推理模型需要基础模型能力支撑，自博弈在非零和领域失效，世界模型可随规模隐式涌现。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields general reasoning; IMO gold shows models know limits, not just math-specific tricks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张扩展测试时算力可带来通用推理，IMO 金牌表明模型能自知局限，而非仅靠数学专用技巧。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated; evals need compute on x-axis; academia needs GPUs.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能难定义、推理算力被低估，评估应以算力为横轴，学术界需加大 GPU 投入。

noambrown.en: Models are superhuman at combining math areas; scalable oversight is key as proofs outpace human verification.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他观察到模型在跨数学领域组合上已超人，但随着证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws remain alive, with exploration consuming more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究实验室；预训练与缩放定律并未失效，探索阶段消耗的算力甚至超过最终训练。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; concrete goals are AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 自动化科学研究是过去一年最大的进展；公司设定了具体目标——1 年内出现 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming grow as models become more capable; talent density and protecting top researchers remain critical.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型阴谋等对齐风险将上升；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者始终至关重要。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems with minimal supervision, but verification is the bottleneck and capabilities remain jagged.
markchen.zh: AI 已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈，能力依然参差不齐。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测体系正陷入危机。

bengio.en: Deep learning defeats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for generalization.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维数灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and world models; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与世界模型，并认为存在性风险概率极低。

bengio.en: GFlowNets sample proportionally to reward, not maximize it; abstraction, causal structure, and diversity aid out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样而非最大化，抽象、因果结构与多样性有助于分布外泛化与科学发现。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he changed his mind: misalignment and self-preservation are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他因 ChatGPT 后转变立场：错位与自我保存已在实验中显现，哪怕 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于构造而非事后修补。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning and baked-in honesty, plus global coordination.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免强化学习并将诚实内建于训练目标，同时呼吁全球协调治理。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, shifting bottlenecks to alignment and decision-making.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2025 年，AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力按缩放定律扩张，瓶颈转向对齐与决策。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams and solo founders gain leverage by building at the edge of future model capabilities, not today's limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，小团队与独立创业者应面向未来模型能力而非当下局限来构建，从而获得杠杆。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early minimal launches matter; cutting features and rewriting in days beats bolting on agentic capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体原生设计与极简早发布更重要；删减功能、数日内重写，胜过事后硬加智能体式能力。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, and multiplayer AI collaboration is underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，长周期委托配合验证闭环重新定义生产力；模型应会反驳，多人与多模型协作仍待探索。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge while keeping safety genuine.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知，同时坚持真实的安全关切。

kolter.en: Frames learning via hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年从假设类、损失函数与优化方法理解学习；神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little in a post-architecture phase.
kolter.zh: 2024 年认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思；进入后架构阶段，模型架构已不太重要。

kolter.en: Safety shifts from scaling alone to explicit training and layers; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，安全从单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）转向显式训练与多层防御；更大的模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: Agent security needs guardrails and sandboxing; prompt injection is a new vulnerability class, not traditional software bugs.
kolter.zh: 2026 年强调智能体安全需要护栏与沙箱；提示注入是全新漏洞类别，而非传统软件缺陷。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; AI is an alien intelligence.
kolter.zh: 2026 年指出自动化红队已超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；AI 是一种异质智能。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI accelerates scientists rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful scientific AI.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标是建立信任的关键；对有用的科学 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture defies the bitter lesson; scaling alone was not the key.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的专用架构与「苦涩教训」相反；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）并非关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it narrows hypothesis space.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对单一实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；它缩小了假设空间。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and local intuition, not lone-genius breakthroughs; understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 进步来自许多中等规模的胜利与局部直觉，而非孤独天才的突破；理解仍属于人类。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and realistic war rooms; mission alignment drives speed at Meta and Anthropic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、亲自试用产品与设定现实的作战室预期；使命对齐驱动 Meta 与 Anthropic 的速度。

fiona.en: By mid-2026, engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新的约束。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time, lightweight planning; design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时、轻量的规划；设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth; docs stay in sync with code, often with AI help, and old processes get audited and killed.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源；文档常借助 AI 与代码保持同步，旧流程被审计并淘汰。

fiona.en: Hiring favors creative builders with product sense and systems depth; managers start as ICs and dogfood the product.
fiona.zh: 招聘偏向有产品感与系统深度的创造性构建者；管理者从个人贡献者做起并亲自试用产品。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone, and safety research needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律是经验性的、平滑的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial but nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年：Scaling（规模扩张）持续；可解释性关键但仍处早期；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: AGI is not a point but a smooth exponential; safety and capabilities are intertwined; the term AGI is meaningless.
dario.zh: 2025 年：AGI（通用人工智能）不是某个点，而是平滑的指数曲线；安全与能力相互交织；AGI 这个词本身已无意义。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年：我们已接近指数曲线的末端；数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来。

dario.en: Scaling laws hold for pre-training and RL; mechanistic interpretability is the key safety tool; enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: 始终：缩放定律对预训练与强化学习都成立；机制可解释性是关键安全工具；企业级定位与安全价值观一致。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain, not everything; tech must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：伟大的产品只解决一个痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first; failure and boredom fuel clarity and innovation.
fadell.zh: 2019 至 2022 年，他深化为：故事定义产品，先写新闻稿；失败与无聊是清晰与创新的燃料。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain, not data; v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：从客户痛点出发而非数据；1.0 产品靠观点决策；专家可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate; AI devices will be a federated set, not one replacement.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文；大语言模型有幻觉；AI 设备将是联邦式组合，而非单一替代品。

fadell.en: Products need three generations: make it, fix it, fix the business; humans stay in the loop.
fadell.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：产品需要三代——做出来、修好它、修好商业模式；人类必须留在回路中。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非次等的数据。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life, not pull us out of it.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大我们的人性、融入生活，而不是把人抽离出去。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; nature is the best designer, and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受、后思考的生物；大自然是最好设计师，艺术是一种药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary skills.
ivyross.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科能力创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills and business fluency more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人类创造力与 AI 的结合，这让创意能力与商业语言能力更有价值。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并明确指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习提升为「智能的暗物质」，认为智能的本质是预测，并强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划能力，提出 JEPA 与开源是通向 AGI 的路径。
