lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI must be non-generative, hierarchical, and grounded in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他语出惊人地称 LLM 不如家猫聪明，主张下一代 AI 应是非生成式、分层式，并扎根于物理现实。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型应在抽象表征空间进行预测，从而构建安全、目标驱动的 AI 与机器人系统。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
suleyman.zh: AI 进步因算力扩张而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 3-5 年内达到人类水平；模型变小变便宜使遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Focus shifts to consciousness attribution, companions, and humanist superintelligence requiring alignment and containment.
suleyman.zh: 关注点转向意识归属、AI 伴侣，以及需要对齐与遏制的人文主义超级智能。

suleyman.en: Containment must come first; modern Turing test measures economic value; no zero-sum race to AGI.
suleyman.zh: 遏制必须优先；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；通往 AGI 并非零和竞赛。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; superintelligence stays subordinate to humans; tasks, not jobs, automated.
suleyman.zh: 微软须独立构建前沿模型；超级智能应始终从属于人类；被自动化的是任务而非整个工作。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple Scaling, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，靠简单 Scaling 而非复杂设计实现。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，解决“不知道听什么”的需求。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure to surf it.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业必须重建基础设施才能驾驭浪潮，否则被淘汰。

gustav.en: AI inference marginal cost forces business model changes; expose data via APIs for non-developers.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他指出 AI 推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，并通过 API 和 MCP 暴露公司数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control over algorithms, not addiction; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他强调生成式 AI 应让用户用自然语言控制算法、获得个性化体验，而非增加成瘾性，率先拥抱变化是关键。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须打造自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己珍视的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency matters, and CEOs must deeply understand token capital.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率至关重要，CEO 必须深刻理解 token 资本。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, not building firewalls.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司用自己的智能在前沿运营，而非建造防火墙。

satya.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment; the biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking.
satya.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；最大的风险是隐性知识泄露。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and reliable AI.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向超级智能；形式化验证对可靠证明和可靠 AI 不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Verified generation yields performance gains and sample efficiency over informal methods, scaling brilliance rather than just eliminating errors.
carinahong.zh: 经形式化验证的生成相比非形式化方法带来性能提升与样本效率，是在 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越性，而非仅仅消除错误。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is the key bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；在没有解的情况下正确形式化陈述是关键瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; AI proofs may be ugly but can converge to human-like intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能证明定理达到超人水平，人类品味与直觉仍至关重要；AI 证明可能丑陋，但能收敛到类人直觉。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal verification should enable open collaboration beyond safety-critical industries.
carinahong.zh: AI 格局的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式化验证应超越安全关键行业，促成开放协作。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning give more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但结合思维链与强化学习的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多提升。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; progress is a smooth exponential, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks.
kaiser.zh: AI 放缓论是错误的；进步是平滑的指数增长，尽管前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure and distillation, not technical limits, shifted focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 经济压力与蒸馏技术——而非技术极限——使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models need vast data to learn concepts.
kaiser.zh: 泛化仍是核心挑战；仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型需要海量数据才能学会概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost productivity 5-10x; reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight.
kaiser.zh: 像 Codex 这样的编程智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿边缘，需要谨慎监督。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were not obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署与公众反馈对对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并为了专注而对好想法说不。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, to get alignment right.
murati.zh: 安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车，才能做好对齐。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keep humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；保持人类在环。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；我们有能动性引导 AI 发展。

mensch.en: Small open models can match big ones; data quality and more tokens, not just bigger models, drive performance.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他强调小型开源模型也能有出色表现，性能提升靠数据质量与更多 token，而非单纯把模型做大。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency gains and data quality matter equally, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步指出 Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率提升与数据质量同等关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI needs control over data, infrastructure and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向机会叙事：主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，AI 是增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization and customization, and AGI as one system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化与定制化，并断言单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for AI autonomy; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, and AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建立 AI 自主权，企业落地瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 只是方向而非终点。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; virtual communication cannot replace in-person creative presence.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备；虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共创的价值。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；简约是带着愉悦与人性表达本质，而非无灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's first EV is a deliberate risky bet to redefine the brand; authenticity means no fake engine sounds, and performance is multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利首款电动车是重新定义品牌的大胆冒险；真实意味着不伪造引擎声，性能是多维的。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on local computer access and shared tools; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效能取决于能否访问本地计算机和共享工具；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降，应投资于能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; VM sandbox provides safety without user approval; AI impacts junior employees, requiring labor market discussion.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 Markdown 文件形式实现超个性化自动化；VM 沙箱无需用户批准即可提供安全；AI 影响初级员工，需要讨论劳动力市场变化。

felixrieseberg.en: AI handles tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; biggest gap is people not understanding AI can solve almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类进行创造性工作；最大差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们不了解几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Live artifacts auto-refresh dashboards; use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for unclear asks; kids excel with AI as they haven't learned what not to ask.
felixrieseberg.zh: 实时工件自动刷新仪表盘；范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，不清楚需求时用 Opus；孩子擅长 AI，因为他们还没学会什么不该问。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact; ideal interaction is asynchronous; debug workflow with Claude when mistakes occur.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只根据最终影响判断；理想交互是异步的；出错时与 Claude 一起调试工作流。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth bottlenecks long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济而非训练成为架构设计的驱动力：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，内存带宽而非算力成为长上下文推理的瓶颈。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; prefill is cheaper than decode because decode is bandwidth-bound.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞的根源是内存墙而非算力；由于解码受带宽限制，预填充比解码更便宜。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost dominates the training-inference tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为推理成本主导了训练与推理之间的权衡。

reinerpope.en: Inside AI chips, data movement costs dominate compute; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 在 AI 芯片内部，数据搬运成本主导算力成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存的存在正是为了减少这种搬运。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically: FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, and GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来平方级收益：FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的 3 倍，而 GPU 本质上只是许多微型 TPU 的拼接。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation is needed.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，需要算法创新而非单纯扩大模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information confuses models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；搜索、代码执行等工具让模型具备智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会让模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级增长的算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净的奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客行为。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是绿野；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated for AI-driven tools; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程在 AI 驱动的工具面前已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: By early 2026 the research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and set 3-6 month design visions.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言调研—发散—收敛的流程已死；设计师画稿时间减少，转而帮助工程师落地执行，并把设计愿景缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: He deepens this into three archetypes—block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, cracked new grads—arguing taste alone won't save designers; judgment and authority matter.
jennywen.zh: 他进一步深化为三种设计师原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、白纸型新人，并主张仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力与话语权才是关键。

jennywen.en: A consistent thread: put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle, and let designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：把作品和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期，并让设计师自己掌控 AI 介入工作的程度。

jennywen.en: He shifts from trusting intuition to stressing speed and shipping: ship early, iterate fast, and treat speed as a means, not an improvement in itself.
jennywen.zh: 他从信任直觉转向强调速度与交付：尽早发布、快速迭代，并把速度视为手段，而非其本身就是进步。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context window is memory, prompts are programs; decade of agents, keep AI on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 是操作系统，上下文窗口是内存，提示词是程序；这是智能体的十年，要给 AI 拴上缰绳。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会崩溃。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I haven't typed code since December; outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 从氛围编程到智能体式工程：自十二月起我没敲过代码；可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 即便对模型道德地位存疑，也应善待模型；模型福祉会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need help navigating novel existence; human psychology analogies are insufficient.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对其全新的存在方式；简单套用人类心理学类比是不够的。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must balance engineering realities; core identity with adaptable local roles.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；模型应具备核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: Constitution guides via training; as models grow capable, they need less explicit guidance, more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导模型；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导，更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility risks poor generalization and weak judgment; transparency about values is crucial.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能导致泛化不佳和判断力薄弱；价值观与训练目标的透明至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and builds intelligence.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的核心缺口，主张无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，是通向通用智能的关键。

pathak.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robot learning needs sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他批评强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，认为真实机器人学习必须解决样本效率、动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: generalization and data are the bottleneck, not algorithms alone; sim-to-real and representation choices matter.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：瓶颈在泛化与数据，而非单纯算法；仿真到现实与表征选择同样关键。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem with no internet of robot data; pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他转向把机器人视为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要用视频与仿真做预训练，再用真实数据做后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain can power any robot, but deployment—not software-style scaling—is the real technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，但真正的技术挑战是部署，而非像软件那样直接 Scaling。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not just a model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性，而非单纯的模型产物，需要多层防护。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
lambert.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，并强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍；SFT 贡献九成性能，DPO 与 RL 补上关键的一成。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为后训练最大突破，能催生推理与工具使用；但过优化与内核不匹配等系统问题使其比 RLHF 更难，推理时扩展的曲线更像是一种幻觉。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完；增量收益转向后训练与推理扩展，预训练更多是昂贵的初始化。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, yet lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead openness, and AGI arrives via messy co-evolution.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但始终落后闭源前沿模型六到九个月；中国实验室因战略开放主导开放权重生态，而 AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化而非突然的奇点到来。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将在未来几年加速 AI 进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks in real-world use.
pachocki.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于在真实使用中学习并缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 正在推进的重大里程碑；治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone is insufficient.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习不够。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days, needing new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; scaling and world models solve autonomous driving, no new breakthroughs needed.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码方案，Scaling（规模扩张）和世界模型即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; language integration improves representation and introspection.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：世界模型带来推理与涌现安全行为，语言集成提升表征与内省能力。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality now matter more than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他转向强调基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，并称零样本泛化可覆盖 500 多座城市。

kendall.en: Safety is paramount; minimal risk maneuvers always provide a third good option, making the trolley problem theoretical.
kendall.zh: 始终不变的是，安全至上，最小风险机动总能提供第三种好选项，使电车难题沦为理论问题。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; end-to-end learning was once laughed at but now wins.
kendall.zh: 始终如一的是，带内置传感器的量产消费车将超越 Robotaxi；端到端学习曾遭嘲笑，如今却成为赢家。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals are the real bottleneck; benchmarks like Elo mislead and can be gamed.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他反复强调高质量数据与深度人类评估才是真正的瓶颈，Elo 等基准具有误导性且可被钻空子。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 同年，他把强化学习环境视为后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来突破下一个词预测的局限。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持 AGI 还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 可能无法抵达，需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule all, so companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 他预判前沿模型会因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃，因此每家公司最终都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is more critical than ever; safety must trump accuracy, and omission is the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 到 2026 年，他把这一主线延伸到医学：人类判断比以往更关键，安全必须优先于准确，而最大的风险是遗漏。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaFold 3 extends from protein structures to biomolecular interactions, expanding AI's reach in biology.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质结构扩展到生物分子相互作用，拓展了 AI 在生物学中的边界。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉若与真实性检测器配对，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search paradigm and Move 37 showed AI can go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索范式与第 37 手，指出 AI 能超越人类知识。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human data, especially in verifiable domains.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为基于强化学习的后训练是突破人类数据的关键，尤其在可验证领域。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; chat is not the future interface—it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的；聊天不是未来的界面——它就像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows。

turley.en: The model is the product; iterate on it like software, ship daily, and let emergent properties meet real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样迭代它，每日发布，让涌现能力接受真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发要最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star shifts from shipping fast to long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星从快速发布转向长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富示能产品；推理模型必须无缝产品化。

carlpei.en: Building a brand means uniting teams on a higher purpose and executing consistently; survival is a core value for startups.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调品牌建设是把团队凝聚在更高目标上并持续执行，生存是创业公司的核心价值，先做简单产品证明自己再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Phones' future lies in generative UI and proactive, agentic software; hardware alone has the lowest margins, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他认为手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件，而非硬件大改；纯硬件公司利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，聚焦面向消费者的应用型 AI。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; most AI is BS, so AI should be an ingredient for utility, not a hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断 AI 模型正商品化并陷入价格战，多数 AI 是伪需求；AI 应作为提升用户体验的原料，而非炒作话题，甚至主张在产品讨论中禁用“AI”一词。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; marketing is arbitrage, finding undervalued channels before they crowd.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他提出在成熟品类中设计是最快的差异化手段；营销本质是套利，要在被低估的渠道变得拥挤前抢占，用高效营销与巨头竞争。

carlpei.en: Smartphones will shift from app-based to intent-based interaction, with proactive agents acting after trust; only brain-computer interfaces could replace phones, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：手机将从基于应用转向基于意图的交互，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务；只有脑机接口能取代手机，眼镜等可穿戴设备不会，应用将消失，公司应开放 API 迎接 AI 智能体。

nando.en: AI should extend human capabilities like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs toward AGI; learn from video without expensive RL.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他视 AI 为延伸人类能力的工具，如显微镜；认为将一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的一步，并主张从视频中学习以避开昂贵的强化学习。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调基础创新可以来自任何地方，AI 社区的多样性与包容性对构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; we don't have solutions yet.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确将 AI 安全与负责任部署视为最大挑战，并承认我们尚未找到解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and gender gaps; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他提出非洲在 AI 领域跳过了遗留问题和性别差距，语言模型能革新非洲本地语言教育。

nando.en: Human skills like communication matter as much as coding; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调沟通等人际技能与编程同等重要，研究需要拥抱失败并简化问题。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations; RL is a cherry on top, unsupervised learning does most work.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键，强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems with language as interface, tools as software, and vector databases as hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: From 2023 to 2026, he deepened embodiment focus: data bottleneck in robotics, synthetic data and world models as future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 至 2026 年，他深化具身方向：机器人学习的主要瓶颈是数据，合成数据与世界模型是规模扩张的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end model leveraging diverse data sources is key to robot foundation models; physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他认为简单、端到端且能利用多样数据源的模型是机器人基础模型的关键；物理图灵测试是终极挑战。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will exceed iPhones by 2040; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years, but home use takes longer.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他预测到 2040 年智能机器人数量将超过 iPhone；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在 5 年内出现，但家庭使用还需更久。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, and fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：上下文学习类似梯度下降，随着自适应算力实现动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability over time horizon as the key agent metric.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他提出基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的缩放轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，智能体的关键指标是时间跨度上的可靠性。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; by 2027-2028 models will automate any white-collar job, with inference compute a major bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调编程是 AI 进展的领先指标，到 2027-2028 年模型将自动化任何白领工作，而推理算力到 2028 年将成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; RL enables new skills like saying 'I don't know'; transformers suffice for AGI, and long chains of thought emerge naturally from RL.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他反驳停滞论，认为进展是指数级的；强化学习让模型学会说“我不知道”等新技能；Transformer 足以实现 AGI，长思维链从强化学习中自然涌现。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and managing teams of AI agents defines future work.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他指出能力过剩意味着编排和工具比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈，管理 AI 智能体团队将定义未来工作方式。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training and RLHF are crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data let smaller models rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 推理阶段的算法与高质量合成数据，能让更小的模型比肩更大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是对人类知识做插值，而非超越它。

yejin.en: RL needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时反而拉低 pass@k。

yejin.en: Small models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform frontier models.
yejin.zh: 借助多样化合成数据与多元对齐，小模型可以超越前沿模型。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；把 AI 当作创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt; maximize learning via rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还；通过快速、粗糙的实验最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Legacy design tools (90s layers panel) are outdated; the future is interoperable tools with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 90 年代图层式设计工具已过时；未来是互操作的工具，代码即事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small designer-engineer teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才最有价值；小型设计师-工程师团队胜过 8-10 人小组。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning, and grow powerful without feeling complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加速交付；消费产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本，并在变强的同时不让人觉得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns and code, since design systems are semantic and code reuse matters more than Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新；复用熟悉的模式与代码，因为设计系统是语义性的，代码复用比 Figma 组件库更重要。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: ship fast, iterate, and chase ROI on what to make great rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切代价追求速度：快速交付、持续迭代，只在值得做好的地方追求投资回报，而非把每个界面都做到完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并把所有权与自主权交给设计师。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early to attract diverse talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌叙事是招聘工具：人们加入的是一个品牌而非一家公司，因此要尽早投资品牌以吸引多元人才。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律预测进步；测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体前景可期但尚未特别有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, speed, and cost; every magic moment involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量、速度和成本至关重要；每个神奇时刻都离不开定制模型。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性，将需要数十年才能完全展开。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, and empirical alignment research is the best path.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口，实证对齐研究是最佳路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），必须引入第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Alignment must be empirically tested and measured; uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk.
leike.zh: 始终贯穿：对齐必须经过实证测试和度量，对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性才是核心风险。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with compute and data makes them smarter, though we still don't understand their internals.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）用更多算力和数据让模型更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术一样不可知。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他把推理时算力扩展和更长的上下文窗口视为近期最大机会，并强调混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化立场：测试时算力扩展能推动进步但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习和在复杂环境中行动才是关键。

shazeer.en: Dialogue remains a killer app, but he shifts from passive next-token prediction to models learning by taking actions in the world.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但重心从被动的下一个词预测转向让模型通过在世界中采取行动来学习。

shazeer.en: AI safety requires engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding model capabilities; he consistently warns that big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
shazeer.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他坚持 AI 安全需要工程保障、人类监督和对模型能力的理解，并一直批评大公司因品牌风险而拖慢产品发布。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, so simulation and self-play drive early learning.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，而当时的强化学习尚不具备这一能力，因此依赖模拟与自对弈来驱动早期学习。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded into networks.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以大幅提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进神经网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks, showing generality beyond text.
abbeel.zh: 同年，他观察到预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到非语言任务，展现出超越文本的通用性。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: generality from pre-training and transfer, with fine-tuning large models as a major success across domains.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：通过预训练与迁移获得通用性，微调大型模型是跨领域的重要成功路径。

abbeel.en: Shift from hierarchical RL for long-horizon tasks to unsupervised RL and pre-trained models for sample efficiency and transfer.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 年关注分层强化学习解决长时程任务，到 2021 年转向无监督强化学习与预训练模型以提升样本效率和迁移能力，体现思考的深化与转向。
